## Governance Checklist

Before submitting this Pull Request, confirm:

- [ ] I changed only files relevant to this update.
- [ ] Partner status matches the defined repository status values.
- [ ] Track and milestone references match the applicable track document.
- [ ] Readiness terminology follows `framework/partner-readiness.md`.
- [ ] Evidence is appropriate for public disclosure.
- [ ] No customer-confidential information is included.
- [ ] No Huawei-confidential or proprietary restricted information is included.
- [ ] No credentials, access keys, passwords, exam vouchers, or secrets are included.
- [ ] No confidential pricing, pipeline value, revenue, contract, or commercial information is included.
- [ ] No unnecessary personal data or private certification identifiers are included.
- [ ] The partner page includes a clear next milestone.
- [ ] Blockers are stated without exposing restricted information.

---

## Reviewer Checklist

For reviewer use:

- [ ] Scope reviewed
- [ ] Track alignment reviewed
- [ ] Evidence reviewed
- [ ] Capability / milestone decision recorded
- [ ] Public-data safety reviewed
- [ ] Partner progress page remains structurally consistent
- [ ] Next milestone is clear
